notes.transfer_bytes: Cold-cache local total transfer including the navigation document and resources. Third-party analytics and fonts are blocked by the quality gate.
notes.article_transfer: The article archive is a pinned external Docusaurus build. Its duplicate 2.5 MB background is replaced during staging with the shared 309 KB asset; budgets retain a narrow ceiling above the measured governed build. The audit corrects an earlier metric that omitted the HTML document: the measured longest image-rich archive page totals 3,921,468 bytes including 677,964 bytes HTML. Its total-transfer ceiling is 4 MiB; this accounting correction is not a performance improvement.
notes.lcp_ms: Local deterministic smoke-test ceiling, not a substitute for field Core Web Vitals.
notes.directory: Initial decoded document <=250 KB and <=3200 DOM nodes; static pagination and progressive filtering preserve full reachability. Lab limits, not field Core Web Vitals.
